# Customer Message Brief & Brand Handoff: Roster Window **Status:** Untested draft **Tone/Voice:** Exact and approachable **Target Audience:** Neighborhood volunteer coordinators (primary), venue partners (stakeholder) **Alternative:** Copied spreadsheets and email threads --- ## 1. Homepage Opening ### Headline **Coordinate neighborhood volunteer shifts without juggling spreadsheets** ### Supporting Line Roster Window lets you import a CSV roster, view assignments by shift, and maintain a dated record of assignment changes in one central view. --- ## 2. Proof Caption > **Caption for Walkthrough Interface Preview:** > *Sample walkthrough view showing volunteer assignments grouped by shift alongside a chronological, dated log of updates. (Sample data shown for illustration. The record logs change dates; it does not log editor identity or guarantee volunteer attendance.)* --- ## 3. Action Expectations & Setup Path ### Primary Call to Action **Request a roster walkthrough** * **What happens next:** Walk through shift views and dated change tracking using a sample dataset. *(Scheduling and response turnaround terms are currently unassigned and will be confirmed after request submission.)* * **What it is not:** This is an exploratory walkthrough, not an instant account provisioning or a live data import. ### Setup Path to Value 1. **Sample Walkthrough:** Tour shift views and inspect how dated change records operate using sample volunteer data. 2. **Field & Role Agreement:** Align on required CSV import fields and agree on coordinator administration responsibilities. *(Prerequisite for setup; completion duration depends on organizational scope.)* 3. **CSV Import & Shift Setup:** Import your existing roster via CSV and publish shift assignments for coordinators and venue teams. --- ## 4. Venue-Partner Pitch Opener > “To make shift handoffs straightforward, Roster Window gives venue partners a clear view of volunteer coverage alongside a dated record of every schedule change. You can see current coverage and verify when an assignment was last updated without sorting through forwarded email threads.” --- ## 5. Compressed Brand Card ```yaml brand: Roster Window category: Volunteer shift coordination target_audience: Neighborhood volunteer coordinators and venue partners core_offer: CSV-based volunteer scheduling with shift-level visibility and dated change records differentiator: Replaces fragile spreadsheet copies and scattered emails with clear shift assignment views and a dated change history. voice_attributes: - Exact: States capabilities, records, and requirements precisely without inflated technical or operational claims. - Approachable: Plain, direct language that community coordinators can put to work immediately. claim_limits: - Deliverable is shift assignment visibility and dated change tracking. - Attendance, actor logging, retention limits, and integrations beyond CSV are not promised. next_action: Request a roster walkthrough (sample dataset) ``` --- ## 6. Revision & Fact-Check Audit ### Before & After Copy Revision | Original Passage (Off-Voice / Unsupported) | Diagnosis | Replacement Copy (On-Voice / Evidenced) | Supporting Input & Boundary | |---|---|---|---| | *"The certified, tamper-proof roster that guarantees every volunteer turns up. Get instant access."* | • **"Certified"**: Certifications are unsupplied/unknown.
• **"Tamper-proof"**: A dated record does not constitute cryptographic or tamper-proof integrity controls.
• **"Guarantees every volunteer turns up"**: Software cannot guarantee human behavior/attendance.
• **"Instant access"**: Production setup requires CSV field mapping and role alignment. | **Headline:** "Coordinate neighborhood volunteer shifts without juggling spreadsheets"

**Supporting:** "Roster Window lets you import a CSV roster, view assignments by shift, and maintain a dated record of assignment changes in one central view."

**Action:** "Request a roster walkthrough" | • Supported: CSV import, shift display, dated change record.
• Removed: Attendance guarantee, certification claims, tamper-proof claim, instant provisioning. | --- ### Fact Boundary & Claim Review | Element / Claim in Copy | Evidentiary State | Copy Boundary & Decision | Open Owner Questions | |---|---|---|---| | **Import CSV roster** | Supplied fact | Permitted: Mentioned as primary data intake mechanism. | Are non-CSV file formats planned or supported? | | **Shift assignment view** | Supplied fact | Permitted: Framed as coordinator visibility into volunteer shifts. | None; capability confirmed. | | **Dated change record** | Supplied fact | Permitted: Described strictly as a "dated record of updates." Must *not* be termed "audit trail," "tamper-proof," or "immutable." | What timezone is recorded? Is historical export available? | | **Actor identity (who changed what)** | Unknown | Omitted: Do not claim user attribution. Do not claim absence; leave unknown. | Does the change record capture user IDs or coordinator names? | | **Retention duration** | Unknown | Omitted: No timeframe promised for change record storage. | How long are dated change records retained? | | **Integrity / Security controls** | Unknown | Omitted: No claims regarding tamper-evidence or data hardening. | Are there integrity controls on change logs? | | **Certifications & Compliance** | Unknown | Omitted: Keep unmentioned. Do not state "uncertified." | Are there relevant security/privacy certifications? | | **Volunteer attendance** | Unsupported / Non-deliverable | Omitted: Product displays assignments; it cannot guarantee attendance. | Are check-in/attendance confirmation features planned? | | **Integrations** | Unknown (beyond CSV) | Omitted: Only CSV import is claimed. | Are calendar or email integrations roadmap items? | | **Setup & Scheduling SLA** | Unknown / Proposal | Stated as prerequisite: Setup requires agreeing import fields and owner responsibilities. No timeline promised. | What is the standard response SLA for walkthrough requests? What is typical onboarding duration? | --- ## 7. Next Owner Handoff * **Product Design & UX:** Define the walkthrough request form inputs, submission confirmation feedback, and sample data viewer states. * **Go-to-Market / Product Owner:** Resolve open questions regarding walkthrough scheduling SLAs, change-record actor attribution, and CSV field specifications prior to public release.
